remarks: Welcome to this beautifully designed and immaculately maintained townhome in Palmer Hill - a gated, award-winning enclave ideally positioned on the Old Greenwich/Stamford border. This elegant and light-filled Chester model offers over 5,000 sq ft of stylish living space, with 3/4 bedrooms, 4.5 baths, and a flexible open layout filled with natural light. The just-renovated gourmet kitchen features a large quartz island, Viking stove, wine cooler, and stainless steel appliances, and opens seamlessly to the living/dining area with soaring ceilings, a gas fireplace, and access to a private deck-perfect for entertaining. The main-level primary suite includes a spa-like bath with soaking tub, glass-enclosed shower, and double vanity. Upstairs offers two ensuite bedrooms and a versatile den or home office. The fully finished walk-out lower level includes a full bath and flexible space ideal for a media room, gym, or guest bedroom. Enjoy resort-style amenities: newly renovated clubhouse, heated pool, hot tub, fire pit, business center, and fitness center with yoga room. Conveniently located near Metro North, I-95, beaches, shopping, and dining. A rare opportunity for luxury, low-maintenance living in one of the area's most desirable communities.
